# ⚠️ This is a Mirror Repository

> Anthropic 公式の GitHub Actions ベースアクション。CI/CD パイプライン上で Claude Code を自動実行するための TypeScript 実装（プロンプト準備・環境検証・SDK 実行・設定セットアップ）を提供する。

## Source Modules

- [src.execution-file](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-base-action/blob/main/src/execution-file.ts)
- [src.index](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-base-action/blob/main/src/index.ts)
- [src.prepare-prompt](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-base-action/blob/main/src/prepare-prompt.ts)
- [src.run-claude-sdk](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-base-action/blob/main/src/run-claude-sdk.ts)
- [src.run-claude](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-base-action/blob/main/src/run-claude.ts)
- [src.setup-claude-code-settings](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-base-action/blob/main/src/setup-claude-code-settings.ts)
- [src.validate-env](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-base-action/blob/main/src/validate-env.ts)
